title: Akash
value: Inducted and operational with the Indian Army and Indian Air Force; short-range surface-to-air missile system.

title: BrahMos
value: Inducted and operational with the Indian Navy and Indian Army; land-, sea-, and air-launched supersonic cruise-missile system.

title: MRSAM
value: Jointly developed with IAI for IAF and Army Air Defence; firing units have been delivered to both users.

title: Guided Pinaka Rocket System
value: Guided Pinaka development and qualification activities were reported complete, with the trial team recommending induction; upgraded in-service launchers remained under evaluation.

title: MoD signs ₹62,370 crore contract with HAL for procurement of 97 LCA Mk1A aircraft for IAF
value: MoD signed a contract for 97 LCA Mk1A aircraft on 25 September 2025; deliveries were stated to start in 2027–28 and complete over six years.

title: Indian Army procures critical CBRN defence equipment
value: Contract signed on 25 February 2025 for 223 Automatic Chemical Agent Detection and Alarm systems designed by DRDO's Defence Research and Development Establishment and procured from L&T.

title: MoD inks ₹6,900 crore contracts for ATAGS and HMV 6x6 gun-towing vehicles
value: MoD signed contracts on 26 March 2025 for 155 mm/52 calibre ATAGS and 6x6 gun-towing vehicles; ATAGS is intended to replace vintage smaller-calibre guns.

title: MoD inks contracts for NAMIS Tracked and light vehicles
value: MoD signed a contract on 27 March 2025 for the NAMIS tracked anti-tank weapon platform; the system is intended to modernize mechanized-infantry anti-tank capability.

title: Successful field evaluation trials of Nag Mk 2
value: Field evaluation trials were reported successful on 13 January 2025 and the weapon system was described as ready for induction.

title: MoD and BDL sign contract for INVAR anti-tank missiles
value: MoD and BDL signed a ₹2,095.70 crore contract on 13 November 2025 for INVAR anti-tank missiles for T-90 tanks.

title: PM dedicates INS Surat, INS Nilgiri and INS Vaghsheer
value: The three platforms were commissioned on 15 January 2025.

title: INS Arnala commissioned into the Indian Navy
value: INS Arnala was commissioned on 18 June 2025; it is an ASW shallow-water craft, 77 m long and over 1,490 tonnes, designed for subsurface surveillance/interdiction, search and rescue, and low-intensity maritime operations.

title: INS Nistar commissioned in Vizag
value: INS Nistar, the first indigenously designed and constructed diving support vessel, was commissioned on 18 July 2025 for deep-sea diving and rescue operations.

title: INS Tamal commissioned into the Indian Navy
value: INS Tamal was commissioned on 1 July 2025; it is the eighth Project 1135.6 multi-role stealth frigate and second additional Tushil-class ship.

title: INS Udaygiri and INS Himgiri commissioned
value: INS Udaygiri and INS Himgiri were commissioned on 26 August 2025 as Project 17A stealth frigates.
